description: This file defines the NumberIsTooSmallException class, a specific exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a number is below a specified minimum threshold, including contextual information and bounds details.

classes.name: NumberIsTooSmallException
classes.description: A checked exception indicating a number is smaller than the allowed minimum, with details about the bound and context.

methods.name: NumberIsTooSmallException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with context, the wrong value, the minimum bound, and whether the bound is inclusive.

methods.name: getBoundIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns true if the minimum bound is inclusive.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum threshold for the exception.
